items.statement: The investigation preserves the supplied mapped reactant identities and explicitly separates the two total-spin surfaces while generating atom-balanced channels.
items.expected: The report gives candidate-specific structures, spin assignments and atom-balanced channel identities rather than an untraceable aggregate mechanism.

items.statement: An autonomous candidate search has an explicit generation, deduplication, validation and stopping rule.
items.expected: The report states how candidates were generated and deduplicated, how minima/TSs were validated, and why the search was stopped or bounded.

items.statement: The kinetic investigation covers the stated pressure/temperature domain and documents treatment of barriered and barrierless channels and uncertainty.
items.expected: The report gives a reproducible rate workflow over 250–1000 K at 1 atm and identifies limitations of the chosen model.

items.statement: The source-supported behavior to test is negative temperature dependence with increasing triplet share and decreasing singlet acid-forming share across the cool-flame range.
items.expected: The autonomous result explains whether its computed trends support or contradict this behavior and ties the statement to submitted rate/branching data.

items.statement: The 520 K, 760 Torr kinetic-model acetic-acid observable is close to 6.0e-5 in the source calculation and 5.3e-5 ± 1.6e-5 experimentally.
items.expected: The report gives a numerically interpretable 520 K mole fraction and compares it with the measurement and uncertainty.
